subsection.subsection: A taxing entity may not approve an agreement under this section on behalf of another taxing entity.

Subject to Subsection (2)(b), a tax lien under this chapter against the taxpayer's property is not affected by a payment pursuant to an agreement under this section to the extent of the difference between the amount the taxpayer would have been required to pay in the absence of the agreement and the amount of the payment under the agreement.

For purposes of enforcing a tax lien under this chapter, a taxpayer's failure to pay the full amount of taxes that the taxpayer would have been required to pay in the absence of an agreement under this section does not constitute a failure to pay the full amount of taxes owing: if the taxpayer pays the full amount of the payment owing under the agreement; and unless the taxpayer:
files for bankruptcy; transfers ownership of the property that is the subject of the property taxes; or has a change in ownership and the new owner does not assume all responsibility and liability under the agreement.

The commission may revise, accelerate, or cancel an equal payment agreement under this section to the same extent and for the same reasons that the commission may revise, accelerate, or cancel an installment agreement under Section 59-1-1004.
The commission shall give the taxpayer reasonable notice of its intent to revise or cancel an equal payment agreement under this section.

section.subsection: The commission shall promulgate rules to ensure that tax revenue derived from payments pursuant to an agreement under this section do not affect the calculation of the certified tax rate under Section 59-2-924.

If the commission or a taxing entity enters into an equal payment agreement under this section:
the commission shall annually provide an electronic report to the Revenue and Taxation Interim Committee on the effects of equal payment agreements under this section; and the Revenue and Taxation Interim Committee shall annually review and assess the effects of equal payment agreements under this section.
